description: Two-seat Starfighter at Ataşehir Mahallesi in Çiğli, wearing the code 9-911. Construction number 583F-5911. The International F-104 Society records refurbishment in 2017 and a move in 2021 or 2022; spottingmode's record was updated on 2 June 2026, the most recent evidence for any monument in this set.
